opening.argument: The material directly promotes recurring income through the creation of multiple blockchain nodes. Its title promises "$5000 a month passive income," while the description urges viewers to "Get 10 node set up and make $5000 a month right now!!" The spoken promotion reinforces that message with "No! 5000 and up!" This is not merely a discussion of blockchain technology: the frame shows a webpage headed "Easily Create Blockchain Nodes" and "Earn Rewards," including a node-naming step displaying "CYBER NODE." Together, these statements and visuals connect immediate participation in ten nodes, including naming a node and confirming transactions, to claimed recurring rewards of $5,000 or more per month.

citations.quote: Strong Node... Get 10 node set up and make $5000 a month right now!!
